title: Repeated-ZFIN removal consumes a preceding UTF-8 continuation byte
trigger: After initial valid ZFIN, feed UTF-8 个 immediately followed by one valid repeated hex ZFIN and then $ ; invoke finish_without_farewell.
impact: The ordinary terminal text loses byte 0xaa, turning valid UTF-8 e4b8aa into invalid e4b8. Same retained-tail corruption can occur before actual OO. File bytes and FileSaved receipts are not implicated.
proof_kind: Deterministic source trace; no new Rust regression was compiled or executed by reviewer. Parent centralized regression requested.
proof: 0xe4 and 0xb8 are retained ordinary noise at codec.rs:570-577.
0xaa & 0x7f == 0x2a, so codec.rs:570-579 starts a header candidate at the final byte of 个.
probe_header at 316-329 permits three padding stars: the 0xaa byte and both ordinary 0x2a ZFIN padding bytes. CRC validation succeeds for the actual frame at 365-366.
The new truncate at 590-592 subtracts the entire candidate length, including preceding ordinary 0xaa. finish_without_farewell emits the shortened buffer.
requested_regression: Feed initial valid ZFIN; then ["个".as_bytes(), encode_header(Finish,0,Hex).as_slice(), b"$ "].concat(); assert finish_without_farewell == [FarewellMissing, Terminal("个$ ".as_bytes().to_vec())]. Also check fragmented feeds and the strict OO terminal path.
recommendation: HOLD until raw-tail boundary preserves preceding ordinary UTF-8 bytes while removing only the repeat frame.
